patch.summary: Rename a repository, change its description, visibility, default branch or maintainers
patch.description: Owners of the account and admins of the organization only. Send `If-Match` with the ETag you read. A rename keeps working at the old address: it answers `308` with the new one, and webhooks, mirrors and variables move with the repository. Making a repository private hides it from everyone who could only see it because it was public. Maintainers must be people; changing them re-checks policy.

Results are one ordered list with no cap: title matches first, then newest. Only repositories you can read are searched.

get.summary: Keep a local copy of a repository up to date
get.description: Call without a cursor for a snapshot of the repository, its changes and its issues. Then call with the returned cursor to get only what changed, newest state of each object. When `reset` is true the cursor was too old or ahead of this log and `objects` is a fresh snapshot. One request replaces polling every list.

repos.description: `owner/name`. Limits the token to these repositories

get.description: You can read your own uploads with a token that has `repo:read`; without it the read answers `403 insufficient_scope`. Once a file is attached to a change, anyone who can read that repository can read it. Served with `nosniff` and a sandboxing policy; only images and video display inline. The ETag is the SHA-256, and the content never changes.

304.description: Not modified. Costs no rate-limit units.

put.description: The address comes from `uploads.create`. It carries its own signature in `exp` and `sig`, so this needs no token. Send the bytes as the body with the declared Content-Type and exactly the declared size.

*/*.description: Send the bytes with the Content-Type declared when the upload was created.

304.description: Not modified. Costs no rate-limit units.

post.summary: Announce a file you are about to upload
post.description: Say what the file is. The response has an `upload_url`: PUT the bytes there with the same Content-Type, no token needed. The address works once, for exactly this type and size, for an hour. The first bytes of images and video are checked against the type.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Run every check and change nothing. The answer is what would have been returned, with Sx-Dry-Run: true.

actions.description: What the caller may do now. Null in events and sync, which are not tied to a viewer.

maintainers.description: People who can approve core-path changes. A maintainer also has repository write access: adding one grants it, and removing one revokes the write access that maintainer list granted unless the person has another grant.

label.description: The short name reviewers use, such as F-2

secrets.description: Which of the names are secret, so a caller can scrub them from output

set.description: Whether a value is set in the environment asked for. Null when none was

expires_at.description: Null until a person approves it

patch.description: Unified diff hunks. Cut at 64 KB; see `truncated`

ref.description: The commit the ref was resolved to

path.description: The directory listed. Empty for the root

has_more.description: True when the directory has more than 2,000 entries and the list was cut

change.description: The change this run works on, if any

scopes.description: What the run token may do

token.description: The run token. Only in the response that starts the run, never again

attempts.description: Only when you read one delivery

payload.description: Only when you read one delivery

secret.description: Signing secret. Only in the response that creates it or rotates it

snippet.description: Where the words match in the body, when not in the title

score.description: 3 title has every word, 2 some, 1 body only

cursor.description: Send as cursor to get what changed after this

reset.description: True when the cursor was too old or ahead of this log; objects is a fresh snapshot

prefix.description: The first characters, to recognise a token by

secret.description: The token itself. Only in the response that creates it, never again

upload_url.description: PUT the file here. Needs no token. Once, for an hour

content_url.description: Where the file can be read, once it is uploaded

bearer.description: A token starting sxp_ (person), sxb_ (bot), sxr_ (run) or sxo_ (OAuth). Tokens always expire.
